items.text: UJehova wakhuluma kuMose naku-Aroni, wathi:
Bala inani lamadodana kaKohati emadodaneni kaLevi, ngensendo zawo, ngezindlu zawoyise,
kusukela koleminyaka engamatshumi amathathu langaphezulu kusiya koleminyaka engamatshumi amahlanu, bonke abangena empini ukwenza umsebenzi ethenteni lenhlangano.
Lena iyakuba yinkonzo yamadodana kaKohati etendeni lokuhlangana mayelana nezinto ezingcwelengcwele.
Lapho ikamu lisuka, u-Aroni namadodana akhe kumelwe beze, bakhumule isembozo bamboze umphongolo wobufakazi ngaso.
Ubeke phezu kwayo isigubungelo sezikhumba zamatahasi, wendlala phezu kwayo indwangu ebubende yodwa, ufake izinti zayo.
Phezu kwetafula lesinkwa sokubukwa kumelwe bendlala indwangu ebubende babeke phezu kwalo izitsha nezinkezo nezitsha nezitsha zokubeka phezu kwazo; nesinkwa saphakade kumelwe sibe phezu kwayo.
Bayakwendlala phezu kwayo indwangu ebomvu, bayimboze ngesigubungelo sezikhumba zamatahasi, bafake izinti zayo.
Bayakuthatha indwangu ebubende bamboze uthi lwesibani lwesibani, nezibani zalo, nezindlawu zalo, nezitsha zalo, nezitsha zalo zamafutha abakhonza ngazo kulo.
Bazakubeka kanye nazo zonke izinto zaso eyisibekelelo sezikhumba zamatahasi, bakubeke phezu kodondolo.
Phezu kwe-altare legolide bayakwendlala indwangu ebubende balimboze ngesikhumba samatahasi, balinamathisele ezintini zalo.
Kumelwe bathathe zonke izinto zokukhonza abakhonza ngazo endlini engcwele bazifake endwangwini ebubende bazimboze ngesembozo sezikhumba zamatahasi bazibeke odondolweni.
Kumelwe basuse umlotha e-altare futhi bendlala indwangu ebubende phezu kwalo.

Kumelwe babeke zonke izinto zakhe abakhonza ngazo phezu kwalo, imicengezi yomlilo, namakhona enyama namafosholo nezitsha, zonke izinto ze-altare; bayakwendlala phezu kwalo isembozo sezikhumba zamatahasi, balinamathisele ezintini zalo.

Lapho u-Aroni namadodana akhe sebeqedile ukumboza indlu engcwele nazo zonke izinto zendlu engcwele lapho ikamu kumelwe lisuke; emva kwalokho amadodana kaKohati ayakufika ukulithwala; kodwa akumelwe bathinte lutho olungcwele, funa bafe. Lezi zinto zingumthwalo wamadodana kaKohati etendeni lokuhlangana.

Esikhundleni sika-Eleyazare indodana ka-Aroni umpristi, amafutha othi lwesibani, nempepho yamakha, nomnikelo wokudla wansuku zonke, namafutha okugcoba, nokuqondisa kwetabernakele lonke, nakho konke okukulo ethempelini. Indawo engcwele nasezintweni zayo.
UJehova wakhuluma kuMose naku-Aroni, wathi:
Ungasinqumi isizwe semindeni yamaKohati phakathi kwamaLevi.
Kodwa yenzani njalo kubo, ukuze baphile, bangafi, ekusondeleni kwabo ezintweni ezingcwelengcwele: uAroni lamadodana akhe bazangena, babamise, kube yilowo lalowo emsebenzini wakhe lomthwalo wakhe.
Kodwa akumelwe bangene ukuze babone lapho izinto ezingcwele zisitshekelwe, funa bafe.
UJehova wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
bala amadodana kaGereshoni ngemindeni yawo ngezizukulwane zawo;
kusukela kwabaneminyaka engamashumi amathathu kuya phezulu kuya kwabaneminyaka engamashumi amahlanu kumelwe uwabale; bonke abangena ukwenza inkonzo, ukwenza umsebenzi etendeni lokuhlangana.
Lona ungumsebenzi wezizukulwane zamaGereshoni ukukhonza nokuthwala.
Bayakuthwala izindwangu zetabernakele, netende lokuhlangana, nesembozo salo, nesembozo sezikhumba eziphezu kwalo, nesifulelo somnyango wetende lokuhlangana,
nezilenge zegceke, nezilenge zomnyango wesango legceke elingasetabernakele nase-altare nxazonke, nezintambo zazo, nezinto zonke zenkonzo yabo, nakho konke okwakhelwe kona. Bona: kanjalo bayakukhonza.
Ngokumisa kuka-Aroni namadodana akhe, yonke inkonzo yamadodana amaGereshoni iyakuba kuyo yonke imithwalo yawo nakuyo yonke inkonzo yawo;
Lona ngumsebenzi wenkonzo ezizukulwaneni zamadodana kaGereshoni etendeni lokuhlangana; inkonzo yawo ingaphansi kwesandla sika-Itamari indodana ka-Aroni umpristi.
Ngokuqondene namadodana kaMerari, kumelwe niwabale ngezizukulwane zawo ngemindeni yawo;
kusukela kominyaka imashumi mathathu ezelwe, kuya phezulu, kuse kominyaka imashumi mahlanu ezelwe, wobabala bonke abangena enkonzweni ukwenza umsebenzi wetende lokuhlangana.
Lena yinkonzo yomthwalo wabo ngokwenkonzo yabo yonke etendeni lokuhlangana; izinsika zetabernakele, nemishayo yalo, nezinsika zalo, nezinyawo zalo;
nezinsika zegceke nxazonke, nezinyawo zazo, nezikhonkwane zazo, nezintambo zazo, nazo zonke izinto zazo, nawo wonke umsebenzi wazo wenkonzo;
Lena yinkonzo yezizukulwane zamadodana kaMerari ngomsebenzi wawo wonke etendeni lokuhlangana ngaphansi kwesandla sika-Ithamari indodana ka-Aroni umpristi.
OMose no-Aroni nezikhulu zenhlangano babala amadodana amaKohati ngemindeni yawo nangezindlu zawoyise;
kusukela kominyaka imashumi mathathu ezelwe, kuya phezulu, kuse kominyaka imashumi mahlanu ezelwe, bonke abeza inkonzo yomsebenzi etendeni lokuhlangana;
labo ababalwayo ngemindeni yabo babe yizinkulungwane ezimbili namakhulu ayisikhombisa namashumi ayisihlanu.
Laba babe ngababalwayo bensendo zamaKohati, bonke ababengakhonza ethenteni lenhlangano, uMozisi loAroni ababalayo ngesiyalezo sikaJehova ngenkonzo kaMozisi.
Labo ababalwayo bamadodana kaGereshoni ngemindeni yawo nangezindlu zawoyise;
kusukela kominyaka imashumi mathathu ezelwe, kuya phezulu, kuze kufike kominyaka imashumi mahlanu ezelwe, bonke abangena enkonzweni yomsebenzi etendeni lokuhlangana,
labo ababalwayo kubo ngemindeni yabo ngokwezindlu zoyise babe yizinkulungwane ezimbili namakhulu ayisithupha namashumi amathathu.
Lezi ziyizibalo zemindeni yamadodana kaGereshoni, yabo bonke abakhonza etendeni lokuhlangana, ababala oMose no-Aroni njengesiyalezo sikaJehova.
Labo ababalwayo bemindeni yamadodana kaMerari ngemindeni yabo nangemindeni yabo,
kusukela kominyaka imashumi mathathu ezelwe, kuya phezulu, kuze kufike kominyaka imashumi mahlanu ezelwe, bonke abangena enkonzweni yomsebenzi etendeni lokuhlangana,
labo ababalwayo ngemindeni yabo babe yizinkulungwane ezintathu namakhulu amabili.
Lezi ziyizibalo zezizukulwane zamadodana kaMerari, uMose no-Aroni ababala njengezwi likaJehova ngomsebenzi kaMose.
Bonke ababalwayo bamaLevi, uMose no-Aroni abababalayo, nezikhulu zakwa-Israyeli, ngemindeni yabo nangezindlu zawoyise,
kusukela kwabaneminyaka engamashumi amathathu kuya phezulu, kuze kufike kwabaneminyaka engamashumi ayisihlanu, bonke abeza ukwenza inkonzo yenkonzo nenkonzo yokuthwala etendeni lokuhlangana,
labo ababalwayo babe yizinkulungwane eziyisishiyagalombili namakhulu amahlanu namashumi ayisishiyagalombili.
Ngokomyalo weNkosi basebebalwa ngesandla sikaMozisi, ngulowo lalowo ngomsebenzi wakhe lanjengomthwalo wakhe; babalwa kanye naye, njengalokho uJehova emyalile uMose.
